headlines.title: California prepares for flooding as king tides and storms threaten Thanksgiving week
headlines.description: California officials this weekend are preparing for storms that could coincide with the year’s highest tides, Thanksgiving and some of its busiest holiday travel days.

headlines.title: Trump hosts exclusive dinner for investors in his declining meme coin
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will reward top investors in his declining meme coin with an exclusive dinner Sunday night as Democrats focus future congressional probes on the president’s business dealings, including his crypto ventures.

headlines.title: New escalations in conflicts in Iran and Ukraine
headlines.description: Days after a declaration toward peace was signed by President Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping, the conflicts in both the Gulf and Ukraine appear to be intensifying. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: COP31 climate talks break down after angry dispute over fossil fuels
headlines.description: International climate talks in Turkey broke down Sunday after the European Union and other nations rejected a draft agreement that had cut all references to fossil fuels.

headlines.title: It was the NFL’s toughest test. Then the 49ers made it look easy.
headlines.description: The Minnesota Vikings’ defense was the NFL’s most difficult all season. Until they ran into the best team in the NFL so far, the San Francisco 49ers.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Democrat Chuck Hubbard has defeated GOP Rep. Virginia Foxx for a congressional seat in North Carolina, NBC News projects, adding to a Democratic wave that is projected to deliver the party at least 258 House seats.

headlines.title: Missouri mom charged with murder after police say 3-year-old died of untreated cancer
headlines.description: A Missouri mother and another caretaker have been charged with murder in the death of her emaciated 3-year-old son, who died from cancer in a squalid, roach-infested home two years after doctors found a tumor on his adrenal gland that his guardians ignored, according to police.
